skills.name: sanmu-doc2md
skills.displayName: 三木 · 学术文档转 Markdown
skills.summary: 将论文、教材与课件整理为保留 LaTeX 公式、高清图表和 Zotero 元数据的 Markdown 知识库。
skills.summaryEn: Turn papers, textbooks and slides into a Markdown knowledge base that keeps LaTeX formulas, high-resolution figures and Zotero metadata.

skills.name: sanmu-paper-reader
skills.summary: 精读论文与补充材料，核对图表证据、复现参数和性能基准，形成可追溯的研究笔记。
skills.summaryEn: Read papers and supplementary information closely, check figure evidence, reproduction parameters and benchmarks, and keep traceable research notes.

skills.name: sanmu-paper-search
skills.summary: 检索文献、扩展引文和匹配 Zotero；集成 Europe PMC 结构化 JATS 全文与补充材料原图包获取、预印本与撤稿核验，可选 Exa 语义补搜及 Serper 检索。
skills.summaryEn: Find literature, follow citations and match Zotero holdings; fetch Europe PMC full text and SI figures, check retractions, with optional Exa and Serper search.
